QuestInfo.name: Evil Eyes in Ellinia
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart has a favor to ask.
QuestInfo.1: The informant in Ellinia reports that Evil Eyes are out of control. Head to Ellinia and thin them out in the meantime.
QuestInfo.2: You went to Ellinia to take care of the Evil Eyes, but it looks like Irena took care of them first again. You're in a bad mood because Irena is always a step ahead of you.

0.0: I need you in Ellinia immediately. Our scout there has reported a great number of Eyes in the forest and then we lost contact.
0.1: Get into the Ellinian forest and clear it out. I'll send you there at once. Accept when you're ready.

1.0: Mihile, did you get any of those Evil Eyes yourself? Well, no matter now. Irena already solved the problem. Though I'm sure the locals will thank you for culling the monster population.

yes.0: I'll contact you next time you're of use.\r\k#b(Irena keeps beating you to the punch. At this rate, you'll be out of work...)

mob.0: Go east from the Six Path Crossway to the forests of Ellinia. Eliminate 80 Evil Eyes.
